card.summary: No upper limit. Base 3 TB included from EUR 15/mo; EUR 3.50 per additional TB.

free_tier.stated: No upper limit. Base 3 TB included from EUR 15/mo; EUR 3.50 per additional TB.

egress.terms: Vendor terms state: '5x free egress, no API charges and no minimum storage period.' Documentation specifies that MEGA S4 allows up to 5x the average monthly stored data as free egress.

record.interface_detail: S3-compatible (SigV4). Endpoint probed live: https://s3.eu-amsterdam-1.megas4.com/ returns HTTP 400 with {Code:InvalidRequest, Message:'Please use AWS Signature Version 4 for authentication'}. A real, correctly-implemented S3 endpoint, not a marketing page.
record.tooling: rclone (first-party guide), AWS CLI, Synology Hyper Backup, TrueNAS, Duplicacy, MSP360, Cyberduck, Terraform
record.chaining: Native S3 -> any S3 client; first-party Cloudflare CDN guide documented at help.mega.io/megas4/setup-guides/cloudflare-setup-guide-for-mega-s4
record.limits_note: None on object size published. Egress beyond 5x stored is metered and charged.

identity_cost.detail: the MEGA account is created with an email address and a password, confirmed by a link MEGA emails, and the vendor's guide lists no phone field, so whether the form asks a phone number is unverified. MEGA S4 is sold on the Pro Flexi plan, and the upgrade takes Visa or Mastercard, Google Pay, Bitcoin or a UnionPay bank card

record.reliability_note: MEGA has run since 2013; S4 is a newer product line (2025) so the durability record on S4 itself is short. Brand-level: no mass data-loss event. Note the 2013 MEGA breach was credential/architecture, not storage loss.

egress.terms: Not metered per GB, but free/non-account downloads are throttled by a transfer quota computed on your IP over the past six hours. Paid users are metered per account instead and can grant a slice of their quota to link downloaders (25% default).

record.tooling: Native rclone backend 'mega' (Tier 2, v1.41+); official MEGAcmd CLI; MEGA S4 (S3-compatible) is the paid object store.
record.chaining: 20 GB + N x 5 GB achievements per account, x unlimited free accounts. Achievement bonuses are per-account and do NOT compound within one account beyond one of each, so the multiplication is accounts, not achievements.

record.limits_note: Transfer quota is calculated per IP address over 6-hour windows on free accounts. Bonus storage achievements expire after 365 days. Client-side encryption is enforced across uploads.
record.reliability_note: Does not lose data; throttles hard per IP and per link. Accounts with no login for ~3 months are at risk of quota cuts.
